newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta index ends 0.44 pct lower in mixed trading.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta index ends 0.44 pct lower in mixed trading.

text.p: Jakarta share prices ended 0.44 percent lower on Thursday, dragged down by investors who continued selling stocks of Bank Negara Indonesia (BNI) and other blue chips, brokers said.
They said a sharp fall in heavyweight Telkom, despite its $1/4-rise in New York overnight to close at $34-1/4 per American Depository Share, helped push the index down.
The Jakarta Composite Index fell 3.05 points to close at 683.12 points after hitting an intra-day high of 689.39 points. Gainers led losers by 69 to 54, with 57 counters unchanged.
